local_vs_server_note: The local Windows checkout has core.autocrlf=true, so its V1 working-tree bytes differ from the server LF checkout even though the stored git blobs are identical (verified via git hash-object). The frozen V1 verifier expectations were computed on the local CRLF worktree, so on the LF checkout the three v1_historical_immutable / v1_verifier_dir_immutable checks fail on line endings only, not on content.
